unavailable_fields.per_operator_peak_allocation_attribution: The torch collector already ran and coverage.json shows only cpu_op/kernel association evidence (88/88 associated, 0 unassociated) with no allocator memory events captured; no re-run is requested and no available collector reports per-op caching-allocator bytes, so the op that sets max_memory_allocated stays unattributed.
unavailable_fields.gpu_consumer_release_bounds: execution_timeline reports clock alignment bounds for CPU submissions only and GPU readiness and consumer completion may remain unknown, so GPU-side release timing of activations cannot be bounded; with explicit torch.cuda.synchronize() boundaries already in the source it is not selected for this single-device workload.
unavailable_fields.pcie_nvlink_wire_bytes: Single-device task (observations.json marks communication not_applicable) with no NCCL activity; device_telemetry exposes device-wide NVML PCIe rates in native windows, not per-transfer bytes, and traffic must not be inferred from logical payload or memcpy sizes.
unavailable_fields.nccl_wait_vs_wire_separation: No NCCL kernels exist in this inference workload, and nsys timelines alone do not separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer; dimension not applicable.
unavailable_fields.gradient_bucket_identity: Inference-only workload with no gradients or DDP buckets; exact bucket links would require native correlation and observed gradient-storage membership, neither of which exists here.
unavailable_fields.cuda_graph_attribution: binding_backend is legacy and coverage.json shows 0 ambiguous forward sequences, 0 unassociated kernels and 0 autograd ranges, so no overlap, graph-tracing or attribution question remains for nsys to resolve.

plan.rationale: Frozen objective is peak_allocated_bytes for single-GPU fp32 ResNet-18 inference (batch 32) under images_per_second >= 0.95x baseline and logits/exact-top1 fidelity. The torch collector already ran and coverage.json shows 88/88 kernels associated with 0 unassociated, 0 autograd ranges and 0 ambiguous forward sequences, so no overlap, graph-tracing or attribution gap justifies nsys or execution_timeline. observations.json marks communication not_applicable (single-device, distributed_backend null), so collective_calibration and per-collective telemetry dimensions are excluded, and device_telemetry's device-wide NVML readings in native windows cannot resolve allocator-internal peaks within one ~ms-scale forward. python_runtime perturbs execution and its inclusive/self times are not clean scores for the throughput constraint. The actionable lever is candidate evaluation, so candidate_diagnostics alone is selected to measure per candidate the objective (peak_allocated_bytes), the constraint (images_per_second), fidelity (logits_max_abs_error, exact_top1_match) and peak composition (parameter_resident_bytes, a fixed ~46.8 MB fp32 floor of 11,689,512 params, versus peak_transient_activation_bytes, the reducible activation scratch).
